retrievalProfile.description: A centered solitary figure viewed from behind standing at the edge of a geometric structure overlooking a vast, hazy body of water and distant mountains.
triggerTerms: man standing on diving board looking at ocean
solitary figure back to camera vast horizon
low angle perspective looking up at person on ledge
excludeWhen: the figure needs to be facing the camera
a busy urban environment is required
vibrant or neon color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, low-angle photograph of a man standing on the tip of a diving board, facing away from the viewer toward a calm, expansive sea. The composition is split horizontally by a soft, hazy horizon line with faint mountain silhouettes, while the diving board creates a sharp diagonal leading line from the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: The diving board acts as a geometric anchor pointing toward the central figure.
The figure's dark silhouette contrasts against the bright, hazy sky and water.
The vast negative space of the sky and sea emphasizes the solitude of the subject.
The low-angle perspective creates a sense of height and anticipation.
coreInvariants: The subject must be viewed from behind (rear view).
The horizon line must be soft and atmospheric, not sharp.
The diving board must originate from the bottom edge of the frame.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium-full shot, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The base of the diving board at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal diving board upward to the figure, then outward to the expansive horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper two-thirds (sky) and lower sides (water).

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted cerulean and slate blues in the water and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and deep indigo in the figure's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale beige/grey of the diving board surface.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high-key, hazy background and a low-key, high-contrast subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all elements to maintain minimalism.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the original.
Provides a similar classic but modern sans-serif feel.
Offers clean geometric proportions and excellent legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a man in a dark t-shirt and jeans standing at the end of a concrete diving board, seen from behind. The board should point from the bottom center toward the middle. The background is a vast, calm sea with a hazy horizon and faint mountains under a cloudy blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. Use light weight, black color, and wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the figure facing away from the camera?
Is the diving board centered at the bottom?
Is the text placed in the top corners with wide tracking?
Is the overall mood atmospheric and solitary?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles.
Do not replicate specific brand logos.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horizon line is level.
Check that the figure's scale feels appropriate to the vast environment.
Verify the text is legible but unobtrusive.
Confirm the diving board perspective is consistent with the low-angle shot.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solitary figure + geometric leading line + vast atmospheric horizon + corner-anchored minimalist typography.
